original_metadata.title: Explicit unitary decomposition of the quasi-regular representation of a connected simply connected nonabelian one-parameter metabelian nilpotent Lie group modulo a discrete cocompact subgroup
original_metadata.author: Amira Ghorbel
original_metadata.source_title: Harmonic Analysis in One-Parameter Metabelian Nilmanifolds
original_metadata.difficulty_reason: The author constructs a global representation intertwiner by Fourier coefficients along a rational codimension-one abelian subgroup, and organizes its infinite-dimensional induced summands through lattice coadjoint orbits. The proof establishes the rational subgroup needed for an arbitrary lattice, proves the Parseval isometry, and constructs an explicit periodized inverse on a dense subspace. This combines nilpotent orbit theory with lattice and Hilbert-space reconstruction beyond ordinary qualifying-exam Fourier or representation arguments.

proof_review.note: Read the complete Theorem4 proof, its full inverse Proposition9, and local rational-ideal Proposition7, lattice-orbit Lemmas1/2, periodization Lemmas3/4 and quotient-measure Proposition4. The group is nonabelian by Definition6, connected and simply connected over R, nilpotent with a codimension-one abelian ideal; Gamma is discrete cocompact. Choose a rational abelian ideal m and a strong Malcev basis based on Gamma passing through [g,g] and m. W consists of integral m-functionals nonzero on [g,g], Sigma is a Gamma-coadjoint-orbit crosssection in W, and V is the full integral character lattice annihilating [g,g]. U is the exact two-case displayed integral into the Hilbert direct sum rho; the periodized inverse is defined first on finitely supported continuous compact-modulo-M summands. The complete authored Parseval and Fourier-inversion proof establishes extension onto all H_rho. Established Kirillov theory, Malcev lattice facts and prior compact-support counting [3,Lemma3.2] are background. Native source confirms complex-conjugation bars in Proposition9 which pdftotext drops. No separate lattice-existence, isometry, multiplicity corollary or Heisenberg variant is counted.

original_metadata.statement_scope: Full Theorem4 together with its immediately following authored surjectivity/inverse construction (Proposition9), as one unit. The exact lattice, rational abelian ideal, adapted strong Malcev basis and Sigma/V index sets are retained. No new explicit multiplicity formula or arbitrary nilpotent-group extension is asserted.

Named Kirillov/Malcev and prior compact-support counting remain cited prerequisites; supporting results and multiplicity corollaries are not separately selected.
